checkedAlternates.risk: Soybeans are harvested as dry seeds.
checkedAlternates.resolution: FAO classifies soybeans as an oilseed legume harvested primarily for oil/protein meal (group-1), not a dry pulse (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Green Snap Bean is the same species as Kidney Bean.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Green snap beans are harvested immature as fresh pod vegetables (group-2), not dry pulses (group-4).
